source_note: Re0微积分1：用牛顿迭代法求算术平方根
english_source_note: Re0 Calculus 1: Arithmetic Square Roots by Newton Iteration
callout_id: Re0微积分1:用牛顿迭代法求算术平方根#13
statement_en: Suppose the sequence satisfies $$x_{n+1}^2=x_n+1.$$ Prove that for any initial value $x_1>0$, the sequence has a limit and $$x_n\to \frac{\sqrt{5}+1}{2}.$$
callout_body: 序列满足$$x_{n+1}^2=x_n+1$$证明对于任意初值$x_1>0,x_n>0$，此序列的极限存在并且$$x_n\to \frac{\sqrt{5}+1}{2}$$
